p05.label: Space occupied by the aged figure

evidence.quote: DM: The third door… is what looks like an ancient and decrepit old man, although the longer that you look, the more you realize this is actually a middle-aged person, this is probably someone in their late 30s or early 40s, who just looks incredibly old, like someone who's been living rough on the street for… years and years and years, in tattered clothes and pallid skin, unkempt, long hair missing in places, untrimmed, unwashed. Wild-eyed, moving frantically, almost animal-like, twitchy, with a basket on his lap, with a lid over the top of it, open just a crack, and he'll open it and look in, and then slam it back shut and look all around himself again, as if fearful that someone's watching.

DM: In the 27th room!

DM: They're accompanied on the journey through the Rubik's Cube house—the 27th room, it's called, for the prison at the center of it—by the, cartographer and mathematician Menestheus, who was a junior member of the order tracked with—or charged, rather—with keeping track of where all of these weak points or holes in the universe are, and guiding people to and from them. So he doesn't have much useful to say about the contents of this place, because he hasn't really been inside before. He's only brought folks here, and… was left behind at Lord Endless Ending's party, possibly as a sacrifice, possibly because he got drunk and fell asleep.
